mentions.name: hono-inertia
mentions.description: Version 4 of an Inertia.js adapter for the Hono framework, grown out of the tooling used to build Things To Have without relying on full-stack frameworks; it aims to be the best Inertia adapter for Hono and the best way to do SSR in Vue or other frontend frameworks.
mentions.problem: Enables building apps with Inertia and Hono without relying on annoying full-stack frameworks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
1. v4 of my Inertia.js adapter for the Hono framework – https://github.com/brachkow/hono-inertia/pull/6

I want to expand the thing I made to write Things To Have without relying on annoying "full-stack" frameworks, into:

- the best Inertia adapter for Hono

- the best way to do SSR in Vue (or whatever framework you use)
mentions.author: brachkow
